versions.source: AJCC Cancer Staging Manual 8th Edition / NCCN / UICC
versions.provenance: 8th edition staging, verified against AJCC 8th edition / NCCN guidelines; licensed verification standard. Requires R1 clinical verification before unchecked use.
versions.introduction: Oropharyngeal SCC has two parallel 8th-edition stagings split by p16 (HPV surrogate): p16-positive (HPV-mediated) disease stages far more favourably and ignores extranodal extension, while p16-negative disease follows the standard head-and-neck ENE scheme. Clinical N for p16-positive disease is laterality-based (N1 ipsilateral, N2 bilateral/contralateral, N3 over 6 cm); pathological N counts nodes (pN1: 4 or fewer; pN2: 5 or more). Unknown-primary p16-positive cervical nodes are staged as T0 oropharynx. Smoking history over 10 pack-years worsens prognosis within p16-positive stages but does not change the group.

t.label: No primary identified (p16-positive unknown primary with cervical nodes)
Tumour 2 cm or smaller (p16-positive: without epiglottic extension criteria; p16-negative: same size rule)
Tumour larger than 2 cm up to 4 cm
Tumour larger than 4 cm, or extension to lingual surface of epiglottis (p16-positive clinical)
Moderately advanced: invasion of larynx (beyond epiglottis), deep tongue musculature, medial pterygoid, hard palate or mandible
Very advanced: invasion of lateral pterygoid, pterygoid plates, skull base, lateral nasopharynx, or carotid encasement

n.label: Regional lymph nodes cannot be assessed
HPV-mediated (p16+): one or more ipsilateral nodes 6 cm or smaller; HPV-negative: single ipsilateral node 3 cm or smaller, ENE-
HPV-mediated (p16+): bilateral or contralateral nodes 6 cm or smaller; HPV-negative: N2a/N2b/N2c per size and laterality, ENE-
HPV-negative: single ipsilateral node 3-6 cm, ENE- (pathological p16+: 5 or more nodes is pN2)
HPV-negative: multiple ipsilateral nodes 6 cm or smaller, ENE-
HPV-negative: bilateral or contralateral nodes 6 cm or smaller, ENE-
HPV-mediated: any node larger than 6 cm; HPV-negative: N3a over 6 cm ENE- or N3b any ENE+
Pathological HPV-mediated: metastasis in 4 or fewer lymph nodes
Pathological HPV-mediated: metastasis in 5 or more lymph nodes

m.label: Distant metastasis (p16-positive M1 still stages as IV, not IVC)

stageGroups.basis: HPV-mediated clinical: small primary, ipsilateral nodes at most
HPV-mediated clinical: large primary without N3

versions.regionalNodes: Levels II, III and IV jugular nodes plus retropharyngeal nodes; bilateral drainage is common (midline base-of-tongue and soft-palate lesions). Unknown-primary p16-positive nodes are staged as oropharynx T0. Contralateral nodes define N2 in the p16-positive clinical scheme.
versions.histologicGrade: Well differentiated (G1) to poorly differentiated (G3); HPV-mediated tumours are typically non-keratinising with basaloid morphology and are not further graded for staging. p16 immunohistochemistry (70 percent or greater strong diffuse staining) is the staging surrogate for HPV.
versions.histopathologicTypes: HPV-mediated (p16-positive) non-keratinising SCC including tonsil and base-of-tongue primaries; HPV-negative conventional keratinising SCC; basaloid, papillary and lymphoepithelial patterns.
